_source: OMX-F: https://docs.robotis.com/docs/systems/omx/specifications/hardware/ (joint ranges, XL430-W250-T / XL330-M288-T). The upstream URDF has +-2pi placeholders; these are the real ranges. Gripper: 0..100 deg on gripper_joint_1; gripper_joint_2 mirrors it (ROBOTIS URDF/ros2_control mimic multiplier=-1, mujoco omx.xml range -1.745329..0 with equality polycoef 0 -1), so its range is -100..0 deg.
